mapper.select: SELECT a.tenant_id,a.id,a.task_id,a.producer_invocation,a.upload_id,a.production_fence,a.state,a.snapshot_key,a.sha256,a.size,a.media_type,a.created_at,a.updated_at,a.expires_at,a.record_version,a.file_receipt,a.receipt_digest FROM artifact a JOIN task t ON a.tenant_id=t.tenant_id AND a.task_id=t.id WHERE a.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND a.id=#{artifactId} AND t.owner_actor_id=#{actor} AND a.state IN ('PUBLISHED','EXPIRED')

SELECT a.id FROM artifact a JOIN invocation i ON i.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND i.id=a.producer_invocation AND i.task_id=a.task_id WHERE a.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND a.task_id=#{taskId} AND a.state='PUBLISHED' AND a.file_receipt IS NOT NULL AND i.tool='present' AND i.state='SUCCEEDED'
SELECT id FROM artifact WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND task_id=#{taskId} AND state<>'PUBLISHED'
